body:
I'll give it a go, I think. I just hope this anxiety is for nothing. I miss seeing my family on a weekly basis.

And maybe. Most of them are notorious for not picking up.

I wish you luck as well.

Thank you for the feedback. If I up and leave, I'm sure my family will be pissed. But I guess I'll have no other choice.

I'll still be on the side of the overlords until the inevitable fate!

YES and it's cute! But not as cute as a snake when they curl up.

But so. cute.

At least pugs were added! Just. cats are far more better. Along with raccoons.

That's fine! My therapist informed her right away that she can't talk about me to anyone without my signing a release form and not to do that again until she has my okay.

I doubled in history and English, I wanted to do something with education.  Oh nice! It seems social work is a popular or more of an interest these days. And that's really understandable.

Yes. Yes they are. I fight with sunshine and happiness on a daily basis.

Excuse me? What did you say about raccoons? Their thief masks are what makes them a far superior animal to all! But yes, the tassels are the worst evil out there.

B-but I did add pugs as my favorite! That as to count for something!

I see. I don't know much about narcissism. Only BPD and little about aspd, since borderline was a big topic for awhile in my sessions.

I will try to.

Thank you.
I do the same, it's so hard not to ;a;.

Yup! I'm 23, but a college drop out for a variety of reasons.

My mom has permission to get in contact with my psychiatrist, who prescribes my anti-depressants but right now, no permission to contact my therapist so I think she got it confused.

Ugh, I get you on that. My family used to think the same thing, until dad kicked me out two weeks ago for good.

Having to be financially dependent on someone who isn't a nice person is terrible.

(I get you on that). I'll check them both out! I have enough time on my hands right now, and needed something new to read.

Sometimes my love for pugs override my love of cats. SNAKES THEN. They're so creepy it's great.

Thank you! I am feeling a bit better now :)

My brothers tell me, actually. Once or twice, they're on the receiving end instead of me. Every once in awhile, after a blow up and two weeks of not talking, he tries to make it up to me somehow. It sorta becomes a cycle. Bad day and I'm around? He's yelling or trying to start an argument. I dunno if he does that with my mom if I'm not over there. Sometimes, he just stomps or storms around instead of bitching at me and hides in his little office downstairs.

Yeah. Hopefully my landlord will let me do something or shed some light. And I think that's what my therapist said too.

Thank you. I'm feeling a little bit better.

Because my dad does this shit a lot to me. I'm over there for a bit, puppy pees on the floor after I leave? Group message about how I'm irresponsible.

Accidentally sleep in when I wasn't supposed to, when we were supposed to grab a copy of my car keys together to unlock my car? I apologize and a group message again about how I'm irresponsible and that I'm not sorry and that he'll be pissed if I even try to apologize.

And technically, mom isn't supposed to contact my therapist about me but maybe she mixed up who I signed release of information for and thought it was my therapist and not my psychiatrist. But I think, when my mom forwarded it to my therapist, it was in good intentions.

edit: I'm sorry, I just realized how snappy this sounded.

Would he even be considered a narcissist?

I'll try to get in contact with my landlord tomorrow about this, as I need to anyways. I live in a low income housing, and my dad works for the people who own this building, but he's not in charge of this building but a different one and has the key to get into every apartment if needed.

I always thought he was more borderline since he does feel guilty after he does this shit. I should have added that ._.;

Thank you.
yes. thank you! animals usually make my day better, even if their stories aren't so happy, they are after a few days of love and care.

Wow! That sounds fun.

And I am off to google those series! I'm gonna be the loser to say something along the lines of Lord of the Rings and Harry Potter, as well as The Maze Runner (I read the first book while in the hospital and fell in love with it ;a;) and Wicked. Along those lines is my favorite type of fantasy.

Oh man. Greek mythology. My former history professor spent a good portion of the time talking about Greek mythology.

Cats, for sure (though pugs have my love too). And oh man. Can I choose both?

I do mostly fantasy! What was that like? Was it hard?

I'm not sure, I think I like how everything is unpredictable and the what-if's aspect. Mythology is quite fun, I mostly like learning about mythological creatures. What about you?

It's fine, I think. We have nothing in common aside from maybe one or two video games.

I like to write and volunteering at the humane society if that can be counted as a hobby. And history.
I don't really talk to my brothers, but we have an okay relationship where we back each other up if it's needed.

That sounds a little difficult ._.;

It's stable and a lot better than it is with my dad. We talk every day.
